# Review protocol (synthetic test data)

Question: how strongly is grit associated with GPA in university students. Criteria I1-I3 and E1-E2 as in review_protocol.json: primary quantitative studies of university students that report the correlation of grit with GPA and the sample size. Two OpenAlex searches; effect measure r, pooled as Fisher's z by REML; risk of bias with an adapted JBI checklist.
